list.name: Changes
list.comment: tps_client_c, tps_client_api, tps_connector, rot13_connector, rot13_service bump to v0.10. - Extensive code review (AI assisted). Several safety fixes. - Expanded documentation including safety findings. - Missing files from previous check-ins.

task.summary: Update tps_client_common and tps_error to version 0.10 - Prelude to extensive (breaking) changes. - Updated dependencies and to Rust 2024. - Added README.md for tps_client_common - Added test cases - Added safety invariants to tps_client_common documentation. - Code review and tests generated with AI assistance.

Update tps_client_c, tps_client_api and tps_connector to version 0.10 - Prelude to extensive (breaking) changes. - Updated dependencies and to Rust 2024. - Added README.md for tps_client_c and tps_connector - Updated other README.md - Added test cases - Added safety invariants to documentation. - Code review and tests generated with AI assistance.
NB: Does not build as other dependencies not yet merged.

Update tps_minicbor to version 0.10: *API breaking changes*. - Extensive rewrite to remove nom parser dependency and simplify binary parser for smaller implementation. - Defaults to preferred encoding with deterministic encoding an option with the std feature and an allocator. - Supports non-trivial NaN. - Can output EDN with feature std - Extensive test suite including all RFC8949 examples, adversarial examples, deterministic and preferred encoding. - Code review, some bugfixes and tests generated with AI assistance.

Update rot13_connector and rot13_service to version 0.10. - Fixed missed lib.rs update in tps_client_c. - tpsc_client_api.h and tpsc_connector_api.h updated due to tps_client_c update. - Additional test cases - Code review, some bugfixes and tests generated with AI assistance.
Compiles cleanly. 197 of 198 unit tests and doc tests pass. 1 expected failure as I have no C compiler configured on the test machine.

New crate, tps_cose, implements COSE_Sign1, COSE_Sign and COSE_Encrypt0 - ES256 and EdDSA signing - AES-GCM and AES-CCM encryption - COSE_Key support - Cryptography provided by Ring crate in this implementation - Extensive test suite - all COSE WG test cases plus additional semantic tests. - AI assistance for test case design , bugfix and security audit.
Add back c_example from tps_client_c, missed earlier.

Huge breaking update of tps_cddl. - Command line tool and library. - Complete parser for RFC 8610 CDDL. - Optional support for RFC 9165 and RFC 9682 extensions. - Support for CBOR modules based on draft-ietf-cddl-modules-06. - CBOR and JSON validators. - Code generation for tps_minicbor. - Span-accurate error reporting. - Extensive test suite - Extensive testing and validation against normative RFC text.
707 tests pass. 1 expected failure (no compatible C compiler on test machine, known to pass on a different machine).

CBOR ecosystem tooling - tps_cose_tool: command line tool for manipulating COSE objects - tps_edn_tool: command line tool for manipulating EDN objects - tps_cbor_tui: console tool for quickly manipulating and visualising CBOR, COSE and EDN artifacts. - AI assistance used to develop tps_cbor_tui and to review and build test suites elsewhere.

Tree sitter grammars for EDN and CDDL. Workspace updates. - Tree-sitter grammar for CDDL for editors that support it - Tree-sitter grammar for END for editors that support it - Updates to the workspace including Miri support and rules on licensing and contribution.

tps_minicbor v0.10. *API Breaking*. - Significant refactor of tps_minicbor with breaking API changes. - No longer parsed using nom. Faster, smaller, fewer dependencies. - no_std support. No allocator required for preferred encoding. - Support preferred encoding by default. - Deterministic decoding is an option for std targets. - Automatic calculation of array/map sized with configurable depth. - Optional float support. - No support for indefinite length objects. - No support for non-trivial NaN. - Extensive test suite includes all for RFC8949 tests
55/55 unit tests pass.
tps_error, tps_client_common v0.10. - Added test suite. - Added README. Claude code used in development of test suites. 55/55 tests passed.

tps_client_c, tps_client_api, tps_connector, rot13_connector, rot13_service bump to v0.10. - Extensive code review (AI assisted). Several safety fixes. - Expanded documentation including safety findings. - Missing files from previous check-ins.
